description: Rollins, Inc. is an international services company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and through its family of leading brands it provides essential pest and wildlife control services and protection against termite damage, rodents and insects to more than two million residential and commercial customers from more than 800 Company-owned and franchised locations in approximately 70 countries, with the contracted and recurring nature of its services providing it visibility into a significant portion of its future revenue. In 1964 brothers O. Wayne and John Rollins acquired Orkin Exterminating Company and in 1965 the company changed its name from Rollins Broadcasting, Inc to Rollins, Inc., and in 1968 Rollins began trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol ROL, since then growing into a premier global consumer and commercial services company.
